data.name: Aamena
data.long_meaning: Aamena is derived from the Arabic root 'A'imana, which means 'to trust'. It is a name given to girls, signifying trustworthiness and reliability. In Islamic tradition, Aamena is the name of a virtuous woman mentioned in the Hadith, who was known for her unwavering faith and trust in Allah.

in_urdu.name: امنا
